items.question: Is No More Room in Hell 2 crossplay?
items.answer: Yes. The 1.0 release supports cross-platform multiplayer across PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S.

items.question: Can you play No More Room in Hell 2 solo?
items.answer: Yes. Armageddon 1.0 added Solo Mode so independent Responders can practice and learn on every map.

items.question: Which consoles support No More Room in Hell 2?
items.answer: The console release is available for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. PS4 and Xbox One versions are not listed.

items.question: Is No More Room in Hell 2 free?
items.answer: No. It is a paid game with a $29.99 USD base price; temporary store discounts may change the current purchase price.
